description: This file provides a set of utility functions under the enum `WebViewJavaScriptSupport` for interacting with a WKWebView in Swift, including applying debug status and evaluating JavaScript code asynchronously.

methods.name: applyDebugStatus
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into the web view to set the debug status and optional status messages via a JavaScript API exposed as `__openclaw`.

methods.name: evaluateToString
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the web view asynchronously and returns the result as a String.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Converts a Swift String? value into a JavaScript literal, returning 'null' if the value is nil or cannot be serialized.
